name: United States Air Force Academy

athletics.revShareNotes: Federal service academy: cadets cannot receive revenue-share payments; settlement participation status not verified. Athletics run through the Air Force Academy Athletic Corporation (AFAAC); not in USA Today/Knight-Newhouse public-school database.

ratingNotes: FB: Troy Calhoun's triple option — 2022-23 10-win seasons, 2024 5-7, 2025 sub-.500 (not re-verified); Commander-in-Chief's Trophy chase is the program's identity. MBB: bottom of MWC (2024-25 4-28). Olympic: broad sponsorship incl. wrestling, boxing-adjacent, rifle; Directors' Cup ~top-100. Brand: academy/military national cachet. Political pressure is federal (DoD, Congress, Board of Visitors) rather than state.

headMbbCoach.note: Joe Scott (2020-25) believed dismissed after the 2024-25 4-28 season; successor's name not verified (search budget exhausted).

notes: Stayed loyal to the MWC in the 2024 Pac-12 raid (with Hawaii, UNLV, Nevada, New Mexico, SJSU, Wyoming); a federal institution whose conference decisions run through the Superintendent and Pentagon/Congress, not a state. Wrestling moves to the Pac-12 as an affiliate for 2026-27 (from the Big 12). Ram-Falcon Trophy vs Colorado State becomes non-conference. 2025 federal policy allowing service-academy athletes to defer service for pro careers (low confidence) is an event-seed.
note: US News: ranked among National Liberal Arts Colleges (roughly top-25), so usNewsRank is null per schema. Cadet enrollment ~4,000.

Travel subsidies (to and from Honolulu) are a recurring conference-finance issue. State legislature directly funds UH athletics and the New Aloha Stadium project, so state politics weigh heavily. Some sports the MWC doesn't sponsor (e.g. men's volleyball) remain elsewhere (not re-verified).

name: San José State University

athletics.revShareNotes: Opted into House settlement (2025); amount not verified, believed modest.

ratingNotes: FB: 2020 MWC champ (Brent Brennan); Ken Niumatalolo since 2024 — 2024 7-6 (Hawaii Bowl), weaker 2025 (not re-verified). MBB: Tim Miles rebuilt from the bottom; no NCAA since 1996. Fan base: small in a pro-sports-saturated Bay Area market despite the No. 10 DMA.
notes: Stayed in the MWC in 2024. 2024 women's volleyball controversy over a transgender athlete: several MWC opponents (incl. Boise State, Utah State, Wyoming, Nevada) forfeited, players sued the MWC/SJSU, and the issue went national (federal Title IX scrutiny, 2025 executive action) — a ready-made politics event. CSU system budget pressure. Bay Area media market is huge but SJSU's share of it is small. Valley Trophy vs Fresno State becomes non-conference.
note: US News: listed among Regional Universities West (top-5 range) — usNewsRank null per schema; enrollment, endowment approximate.

Chicago market value for MWC media talks.

ratingNotes: FB: FCS dynasty — 10 FCS national titles (2011-13-14-15, 2017-18-19, 2021, 2024 under Tim Polasek); FBS transition year 2026 playing a full eight-game MWC schedule but ineligible for the MWC title game and CFP until 2028 (bowls only as backfill). Other sports stay in the Summit League; wrestling moves from the Big 12 to the Pac-12 as an affiliate (2026-27). Leaves Dakota Marker (SDSU), Nickel Trophy (UND) and Montana State rivalries in the FCS. Natural future full-member or Pac-12 poaching target once postseason-eligible (2028). North Dakota State Board of Higher Education/legislature approval and state funding of FBS costs are political levers. Ex-coach Matt Entz now at Pac-12 Fresno State.
